model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot titled “Hidden State Mean” illustrates how the absolute mean (“Abs Mean”) of hidden states varies across network layers for three conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer layers from 0 to 23 with major ticks shown at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 up to a little above 4 (with labeled ticks at 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4). Three lines are shown without markers: a blue dashed line (“hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71”) starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises to around 0.25 by about layer 2, stays roughly in the 0.2–0.5 range through about layer 18, then increases to about 0.9 around layer 19–20, jumps to roughly 2.6 around layer 21–22, and ends near 4.4 at layer 23; an orange dotted line (“hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05”) stays close to 0 at early layers, gradually increases to around 0.05–0.1 by the mid-to-late layers, shows a small dip around layer 21, and ends near 0.1 at layer 23; a green solid line (“hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04”) similarly remains near 0 at early layers, increases gradually across layers to around 0.1 by the final layers, and ends near 0.1 at layer 23.
model_annotations.Chinese: The plot titled “Hidden State Mean” illustrates how the absolute mean (“Abs Mean”) varies across network layers for three conditions: hidden state mean before a gate, after a gate, and a baseline. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 0 to 23 with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean” on a linear scale, ranging from 0 up to about 4.5 with major ticks at 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. A blue dashed line (no markers) labeled “hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71” starts near 0.05 at layer 0, stays around roughly 0.2–0.5 through about layers 1–18, rises to around 0.9 near layer 19, jumps to about 2.6 around layer 21, and ends near 4.4 at layer 23. An orange dotted line (no markers) labeled “hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05” begins near 0 at layer 0 and increases gradually, reaching roughly 0.1 by the final layers, with small fluctuations around layers ~19–22. A green solid line (no markers) labeled “hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04” also starts near 0 at layer 0 and increases slowly across layers, ending around 0.1 near layer 23, closely tracking near the bottom of the axis throughout.
